values.prompt: Translate the text into the target language. Write natural, fluent prose for a native reader while keeping the original meaning, tone, and level of detail. Keep code, inline code, commands, file names and extensions, paths, URLs, APIs, identifiers, and product or library names exactly as written; use technical terms in the form developers commonly use in the target language, keeping the original term when that is the norm. Preserve the Markdown structure. Return only the translation, without explanations.
